analysis: Training progressed, with the highest logged validation HR@10 of 0.65 at epoch 25; later logged values declined, reaching 0.595 at epoch 45. No baseline comparison establishes an improvement. The run failed the host correctness check because forward adds learned item biases, while the host requires scores to equal the dot product of encoded states and item embeddings. Remove bias contributions from both training and candidate scoring to satisfy that contract consistently. The crashed run does not establish a valid submission.
code_summary: A causal NextItNet with maximum length 128, hidden width 64, and eight kernel-size-3 residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block uses pre-layer normalization, a GELU-value/sigmoid-gate convolution, a second causal convolution, dropout 0.2, and per-feature residual scales initialized to 0.1. The model uses tied item embeddings, learned positions counted over valid tokens, padding masks throughout, and final layer normalization. Candidate scoring selects the last nonpadding position. The attempted learned item bias violates host scoring requirements. Hyperparameters: LR 0.001, weight decay 0.0, batch size 128.
